∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {d m S : ℕ} [inst_1 : NeZero m],
  0 < S →
    ∀ (v : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (X : Fin S → Ω → Fin m),
      (∀ (j : Fin S), Measurable (X j)) →
        (∀ (j : Fin S), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X j) (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin m)).toMeasure ↑P) →
          ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X ↑P →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => (↑S)⁻¹ • ∑ j, v (X j ω)) ↑P ∧
              ∫ (ω : Ω), (↑S)⁻¹ • ∑ j, v (X j ω) ∂↑P = (↑m)⁻¹ • ∑ i, v i ∧
                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => ‖(↑S)⁻¹ • ∑ j, v (X j ω) - (↑m)⁻¹ • ∑ i, v i‖ ^ 2) ↑P ∧
                  ∫ (ω : Ω), ‖(↑S)⁻¹ • ∑ j, v (X j ω) - (↑m)⁻¹ • ∑ i, v i‖ ^ 2 ∂↑P =
                    (↑S)⁻¹ * ((↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖v i‖ ^ 2 - ‖(↑m)⁻¹ • ∑ i, v i‖ ^ 2)
